text: Some families owed us money in eVet. Those bills came across to Scout, and collecting them is part of our everyday work.
Tom Chen's balance counts every open bill, Scout and eVet.
eVet balances came across. Collect them like any open bill.
Open it to see what it was for.
To work on it in Scout, there is Edit in Scout. Then take payment like any bill.
Or send one pay link for everything, eVet included.
Now, on this eVet invoice, click Edit in Scout.
That takes the invoice over. Scout owns this bill now. The same line is here, and the balance is the same.
On the ledger, Balance due is still $155.00.
Now you collect it like any visit bill: Tap to Pay, card on file, cash, check, gift card or account credit.
Very old balances: talk to billing. Writing a balance off is a billing decision, not a button.

The most common mistakes are telling a family their old eVet balance is gone, and treating a very old balance as a button you can press to write off. Remember: eVet balances came across. Collect them in Scout like any open invoice.
